concerns.text: The requirement to measure pseudo-sample perplexity against a held-out corpus and skip the dream phase if it exceeds 50 is entirely missing from the tasks. No task covers the implementation of the perplexity check or the conditional skipping logic.

Constitution Principle VI mandates 'knowledge-distillation loss' for the dream phase. While T002a implements 'DAE reconstruction loss', it fails to include the distillation component required by the constitution and the implementation plan (Phase 2: 'Teacher-Student loss').
The requirement to explicitly flag results as 'insufficient power' when the held-out evaluation set contains fewer than 5 samples per seed is not captured in T005 or any other task.
